title: Identification and analysis of neutrophil extracellular trap-related genes in periodontitis via bioinformatics and experimental verification.
authors: Yu, Miao; Ye, Zhenqi; Ye, Zixin; Wu, Yaping; Wu, Xiang
one_liner_zh: 该文通过生物信息学和机器学习分析NET相关基因在牙周炎中的诊断标志物，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Emerging evidence highlights the significant role of neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) in periodontitis, though the precise mechanisms remain insufficiently understood. This study intends to investigate the comprehensive effects of NET-related genes (NRGs) on periodontitis by bioinformatic analysis. METHODS: The microarray datasets were obtained from the Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) database. Differentially expressed NRGs (DE-NRGs) were identified and functionally annotated. Then, machine learning algorithms were exploited to screen hub NRGs, and a predictive model was constructed based on these hub NRGs. Moreover, the expression level of CXCR4, one of the hub NRGs, was experimentally validated. RESULTS: Eighty-three DE-NRGs were identified and mainly correlated with multiple periodontitis-related pathways. Then, a diagnostic NRG signature based on 7-hub NRGs (LPAR3, CXCR4, F3, MAPK7, KCNN3, SYK, and HIF1A) was constructed using two different machine learning algorithms. The diagnostic NRG signature demonstrated favorable predictive efficacy, with an AUC of 0.929 in the training and 0.936 in the validation cohorts. The mouse periodontitis model verified that CXCR4 and HIF1A was markedly upregulated in periodontitis tissues. CONCLUSION: This study reveals that NRGs hold great potential as a robust and promising parameter for assessing periodontitis diagnosis. Targeting NRGs could represent a potential direction for future research into periodontitis treatment. CLINICAL TRIAL NUMBER: Not applicable.
abstract_zh: 背景：新近证据强调中性粒细胞胞外陷阱（neutrophil extracellular traps, NETs）在牙周炎中发挥重要作用，但其确切机制仍了解不足。本研究旨在通过生物信息学分析，探讨NET相关基因（NET-related genes, NRGs）对牙周炎的综合影响。方法：从基因表达综合（Gene Expression Omnibus, GEO）数据库获取微阵列数据集。鉴定差异表达NRGs（differentially expressed NRGs, DE-NRGs）并进行功能注释。随后，利用机器学习算法筛选核心NRGs，并基于这些核心NRGs构建预测模型。此外，对核心NRGs之一的CXCR4表达水平进行了实验验证。结果：共鉴定出83个DE-NRGs，主要与多条牙周炎相关通路相关。随后，基于7个核心NRGs（LPAR3、CXCR4、F3、MAPK7、KCNN3、SYK和HIF1A），采用两种不同的机器学习算法构建了诊断性NRG特征。该诊断性NRG特征显示出良好的预测效能，训练队列中AUC为0.929，验证队列中为0.936。小鼠牙周炎模型证实，CXCR4和HIF1A在牙周炎组织中显著上调。结论：本研究揭示，NRGs作为评估牙周炎诊断的稳健且有前景的参数具有巨大潜力。靶向NRGs可能代表未来牙周炎治疗研究的一个潜在方向。临床试验编号：不适用。
